name: How long does garage wall framing usually take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does garage wall framing usually take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framing the perimeter or partition walls of a standard two-car garage usually takes one to three days. The exact duration depends on wall height, layout complexity, and whether custom features like door openings, pass-through windows, or recessed tool storage are included. The framing phase is just the initial step; subsequent work—such as running electrical wiring, hanging drywall, taping, mudding, and interior painting—extends the total project schedule. Having clear plans for workbench placement and electrical outlets before the carpenters begin framing ensures work proceeds without on-site delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing a standard two-car garage typically takes one to three days, though full completion depends on subsequent electrical rough-ins, drywall, and finish work.
